newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher, supported by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher, supported by blue chips.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately higher on Tuesday, supported by a rally in blue-chip issues which was prompted by the Dow industrials' rebound overnight, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average climbed 241.12 points or 1.36 percent to finish at 17,933.59. Its June futures added 320 points to 17,960.
"After yesterday's sharp decline in U.S. stocks which hit blue chips in Tokyo, the major global issues headed higher again today," said Keiko Kondo, strategist at Merrill Lynch Japan Inc.
Sony Corp, which has headed the buying momentum in blue-chip issues, rose 60 yen to close at 9,010.
"Once profit-taking brings share prices down to a moderate level, bargain hunters will appear to push them back up again," said Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager.
The second section index lost 4.85 points to end at 1,516.50, with 6.21 million shares traded. The over-the-counter (OTC) index was 7.13 points lower at 1,032.49.
